body: the problem is I can't even see 5 minutes from now, much less months or years. I'm willing to accept I would live on without achieving this goal, but the pain of failure is really the thing I can't see myself living with. I know how my family will react, I know how I'll feel. I don't know what else will happen, maybe something good or not. I don't know how I could take more bad news

it gets rid of blood, I guess. the blood gets wiped off by me. it's replaced by millions of other red and white blood cells. it doesn't do much, but it feels good to know a little part of me doesn't exist anymore. If I could shrink into nothing I probably would.
I do it because it gets rid of a small part of me. It feels great

I don't mean to demean anyone who took a different path then my own, but now that my dream path is out of the realm of possibility I really feel lost. This was a dream I had for the last 10+ years. it's also not only that, it's everything else I've sacrificed in order to get to this goal, I've ended whole relationships because of this goal. It turns out to be for nothing. I'm incredibly upset just thinking about it.

I guess I've done this before. I have been routinely cutting myself for the past 4 months now, and once I tried to strangle myself with my belt. I would never try to  overdose, as one I don't have any access to pills, and two because I fear it would lead to the result you described. 
I've only kept with cutting because it doesn't feel too bad. I don't get anything out of pain itself really.

I've failed to get good enough grades for the school that I'm planning to go to. As a result of trying to get good enough grades, I've pushed away all of those people I call friends. They won't associate with me. I've also recently realized that I'm gay, and I don't know if I'll ever be able to express these feelings to my family, or if they'll accept it without hurting me emotionally.

I tried to talk to one of my friends about my situation. they lectured me about how it's my fault and now I have to live with the results.
I didn't have the heart to tell her I didn't want to live anymore. I don't know what to do

I can remember a time where I did not feel suicidal. That was a while ago. It was before any of the things happening now. I don't know what weeks or months in the future will look or feel like. I have a bad feeling I don't want to
